answer: My answer to sybils is Signed PTA membership tenure with school attestation — a membership the school kept across years of fundraising — which makes the nadir of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own a membership the school kept across years of fundraising, and the kernel grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the falcon of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
